title: Real-Life GTA 6 Car Goes on Sale for $1.3 Million
description: Rockstar Games and West Coast Customs have teamed up to build a real-life GTA 6 car, and it is currently on sale for a staggering $1.3 million.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Real-Life GTA 6 Car is Being Sold for $1.3 Million

The hype surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece continues to cross boundaries. According to a recent report by IGN Games, Rockstar Games has teamed up with the legendary West Coast Customs to build real-world versions of vehicles featured in *GTA 6*. Even more exciting—or perhaps jaw-dropping—is that you can actually purchase one of these real-life virtual cars, provided you have a spare $1.3 million lying around.

## Bringing the Streets of Leonida to the Real World

Vehicles have always been the heartbeat of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise. From high-speed supercars to quirky local cruisers, the cars we drive define our experience in the sprawling open worlds crafted by Rockstar. By partnering with West Coast Customs, a premier name in custom automotive fabrication, the developers are successfully blurring the lines between virtual gaming and real-world luxury car culture.

While details regarding the exact model specs are heavily tied to the secretive rollout of *GTA 6*, the collaboration showcases an unprecedented level of commitment to the game's aesthetic and cultural footprint. West Coast Customs is globally renowned for turning wild automotive concepts into road-legal masterpieces, making them the ideal partner to bring a piece of the *GTA* universe to tangible reality.

## A Price Tag for the Ultimate Collector

With a hefty price tag of $1.3 million, this real-life *GTA 6* vehicle is undoubtedly positioned as an ultra-exclusive collector's item. It is a figure that competes with some of the most expensive hypercars on the planet. For hardcore fans and high-end automotive collectors alike, owning a piece of gaming history on four wheels represents the ultimate flex.

Industry analysts note that high-profile crossovers like this elevate the cultural relevance of modern video games far beyond standard entertainment media, turning interactive pixels into tangible luxury assets.

## Editor's Take

A $1.3 million price tag for a real-life *GTA 6* car sounds like something straight out of a satirical radio broadcast in-game, yet it is entirely real. While most of us will only ever be able to drive it using a controller, this collaboration brilliantly captures the extravagant spirit of the franchise. It is a bold, expensive, and undeniably cool piece of gaming memorabilia.
